De-Identify a Study Inside the Walled Honest-Broker Workspace

Source: R/broker-enclave.R
broker_deid_study.Rd

Requires "deid_ingest" capability (coordinator, honest_broker, or admin). Executes dicomtk::dicom_deid() using the enclave's sealed key provider, records the reversible pseudonym_id -> original_patient_id mapping inside the enclave crosswalk, and writes clean de-identified files to out_dir.

Usage

broker_deid_study(
  enclave,
  principal,
  project_id,
  input_dir,
  out_dir,
  profile = "ps3.15"
)

Arguments

enclave

A "dicom_broker_enclave" from broker_enclave_init().

principal

Authenticated "dicom_server_principal".

project_id

Target project identifier.

input_dir

Source directory containing identified DICOM files.

out_dir

Output directory in the research project workspace.

profile

Baseline PS3.15 profile name (default "ps3.15").

Value

A list with project_id, pseudonym_id, out_dir, and n_files.
